title: Agent API
subtitle: Read-only API for the customer-support AI agent

common.loadFailed: Could not load data from the server.

start.authIntro: Every call must send the header:
start.rateLimitValue: {{n}} calls/minute per endpoint, counted per IP address

capabilities.query: Controlled query: filter, sort, count, group, aggregate

key.title: API key
key.warning: This key unlocks the entire API. Do not paste it into chat or screenshot the page while it is visible.
key.notConfiguredTitle: The API is closed — the server has no key configured.
key.notConfiguredHint: Set the {{env}} environment variable and restart the API. Every call currently returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
key.revealFailed: Could not fetch the key from the server.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Missing or wrong key in the X-Agent-Api-Key header. Also returned when the server has no key configured.
errors.TABLE_NOT_ALLOWED: This table is not in the allowlist. See the Data tables tab for what is readable.
errors.FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: This field cannot be read, filtered or grouped under policy. Check the Filter and Group columns.
errors.WRITE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The API is read-only. No write operation is supported.
errors.INVALID_QUERY: The query is malformed or uses a disallowed operator.
errors.QUERY_TIMEOUT: The query ran too long and was stopped. Narrow the filter or lower the row limit, then retry.
errors.DOC_NOT_FOUND: No document has this slug. See the catalogue in the Documents tab.
errors.DOCS_UNAVAILABLE: The server cannot find the documents directory.

tables.empty: The API currently exposes no readable table.
tables.excludedHint: A DELIBERATE exclusion list — these fields exist on the data but are intentionally kept out of the API. Field names only, never values.

docs.pickOne: Pick a document on the left to read it.
docs.unavailable: The server cannot find the documents directory. The agent currently reads no business documents. The other three sections still work normally.
docs.loadFailed: Could not load the document catalogue.

try.disabledNoKey: No key is configured, so calls cannot run. Set the {{env}} environment variable and restart the API.
try.emptySuccess: The call succeeded. No rows matched the criteria.
try.truncated: … truncated for display. The call returned {{n}} rows in full.
try.truncatedNoCount: … truncated for display. The copy button still takes the whole content.
try.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check that the API is running and that the browser is not blocking the request via CORS.
try.curlWithKey: Insert the real key instead of $AGENT_API_KEY
try.idle: Pick a capability and press Run to see a real result.
try.readFilterHint: Example: { "quantity": { "$gte": 1, "$lte": 9 } }. Allowed operators: $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $in $nin $exists $startsWith, plus $and $or $nor $not. Leave empty for no filter.
